Questions, answered

Anything else? Ask us on WhatsApp.

Which areas do you deliver to?+

DHA Phases 1–8 and Clifton Blocks 1–9, including Emaar Crescent Bay and Creek Vista. Delivery is Rs 200 for DHA Phases 1–7 and Clifton Blocks 3–9, and Rs 250 for DHA Phase 8, Emaar, Creek Vista and Clifton Blocks 1 & 2. We don't deliver outside DHA and Clifton.

What are your hours?+

Every day from 1 pm to 1 am. Late-night cravings are covered: the value deals run right up to closing, so they double as midnight deals.

How do I pay?+

Cash on delivery. 15% tax is added on the bill, and the printed receipt from the kitchen is the final amount.

What sizes do the pizzas come in?+

Regular pizzas such as Chicken Tikka, Fajita and Classic Pepperoni come in Medium 9" and Large 12". The five signature pizzas are Large 12".

Do you have Crown Crust pizza?+

Yes — the Crown Crust is one of our five signature pizzas, Large 12" only: tikka chicken and seekh kabab, jalapeño, bell pepper, onion and olives on rich tomato sauce, finished with creamy Sriracha (with dip of your choice).

Do you have a zinger burger?+

Yes — our Classic Crispy Chicken is a zinger-style crispy chicken burger: a thigh-marinated crispy fillet with mayonnaise and lettuce in a buttered brioche bun. Like it hot? Go for the Nashville Authentic (Hot), cooled by coleslaw and pickle.

Can I order on WhatsApp instead?+

Yes — message 0300 9367865 with your order and address, and we'll confirm the total. Same kitchen, same prices.

Hungry? It’s Cheese O’Clock.
